summary: 按截止时间完成 Game Jam 作品：读规则、按时钟定范围、维护砍需求清单、提交前检查构建。 Plans and ships a game jam entry against a fixed deadline: reads the jam rules, scopes to the clock, keeps a cut list and checks the build before submitting. Use for Ludum Dare, GMTK, Global Game Jam or any itch.io jam, a 48-hour game, or "we're behind, what do we cut". Not for untimed experiments (`prototype-fast`) or upload commands (`itch-publish`).
strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill game-jam，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use for Ludum Dare, GMTK, Global Game Jam or any itch.
Workflow: Get the rules before the theme drops; Prep what the rules allow in advance; Theme to one sentence; Scope to the clock.
需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：prototype-fast 用 gene_gdsk_prototype_fast_v1，itch-publish 用 gene_gdsk_itch_publish_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
